ruleDefinitions.name: PsExec Service Installation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects PsExec service installation and execution events Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ServiceName, ImagePath

sequences.query: ((Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045) AND (ServiceName = "PSEXESVC" OR ImagePath = RGX("\\\\PSEXESVC\\\.exe$")))
